---
uid: Server-Hwa-Vendor-Rockchip
title: "Rockchip"
longTitle: "Hardware Acceleration on Rockchip SoCs"
---

Rockchip SoCs provide hardware accelerated video processing through the Rockchip Media Process Platform
(RKMPP).

> [!NOTE]
> Support is prepared but not yet active. Emby knows about the RKMPP context type, but no detection
> backend for it exists yet, so Rockchip hardware is not currently offered in the transcoding
> configuration.

## GPU Context Types

**RockChip** (RKMPP) is the context type reserved for this hardware.
